name: Reskin Hale
lore: Reskin carries a crown no court still recognizes. He bargains with ruined houses and broken oaths, converting every dangerous victory into leverage for his next claim.

abilities.name: Broken Claim
abilities.text: Once per round, after resolving Mirecoil Traffic, Hollow Veil Sweep, or Glassmere Chorus while pursuing a defeat Contract, advance it by 1.

abilities.name: Ash Tithe
abilities.text: After you complete a Contract, gain 1 Salvage.

abilities.name: Crown Debt
abilities.text: Once per round, after you defeat an enemy while pursuing a Contract, gain 1 Salvage.
